sentences.text:
Akash Alias Kallu And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on
5 November, 2024
Author: Mahesh Chandra Tripathi

Bench: Mahesh Chandra Tripathi
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:173278-Db
Court No. - 42
Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 13050 of 2024
Petitioner :- Akash Alias Kallu And 5 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

Counsel for Petitioner :- Anurag Yadav,Sanjay Kumar Yadav Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mahesh Chandra Tripathi,J.
Hon'ble Prashant Kumar,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned AGA for the State respondents.

2. The relief sought in this petition is for quashing of the F.I.R. dated 28.06.2024, registered as Case Crime No.245 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P.Act, Police Station Pawai, District Azamgarh.
Further prayer has been made not to arrest the petitioners in the aforesaid case.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The record reflects that on account of matrimonial dispute the coordinate division bench of this Court vide order dated 31.07.2024 referred the matter for Mediation and Conciliation Center.

The record also reveals that the J.R.(Crl.)/D.R.(Judl.) has submitted its report dated 16.10.2024 with the remark "None Appeared".
4.

In this backdrop, learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that as there was a matrimonial dispute and the parties have already settled their dispute amicably and the informant is living with her husband, now the Mediation is not required, and a direction may be issued to the Investigating Officer as well as the Court concerned to record the statement of the informant under Section 180 and 183 BNSS, 2023 so that the substantial justice may be ensured.
5.

Considering the factual situation as it is informed that the parties have already settled their dispute, we request the Investigating Officer to record the statement of the informant under Section 180 BNSS, and, thereafter, the informant shall appear before the concerned Chief Judicial Magistrate for recording her statement under Section 183 BNSS within two weeks from today.
In the event, the informant appears before the concerned Chief Judicial Magistrate within stipulated period, the Chief Judicial Magistrate concerned shall record her statement under Section 183 BNSS.

Thereafter, the Investigating Officer shall submit police report under Section 193(3) BNSS in accordance with law.
6.
With the aforesaid observations, the instant writ petition stands disposed of.

Order Date :- 5.11.2024 S.P.
